messages.subject: problem with legend
parts:
Dear All,

Sorry about the cross posting yesterday. I hope this is more appropriate...

My issue is rather simple but with the code below a line plot is created with four lines representing the 4 levels of "vaccgrp". However the legend is not how I would like it. I would like a separate / discrete coloured key for each line, rather than a continuous scale. I have tried using a variety of scale options including + scale_colour_discrete() but get an error message ": invalid argument to unary operator".

Sorry for the rather simple question, but I have struggled with this for some time and despite following instructions on the cookbook do not seem to be able to get this to work.

Another possibly related problem is when I type in update.packages() I get the following message: Warning: unable to access index for repository http://cran.ru.ac.za/bin/macosx/contrib/3.0

Any help most appreciated,

Felix

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: problem with legend
parts:
Felix, 
I believe you need to just call your colour variable as.factor and then it will treat it as discrete rather than continuous.

ggplot(data=df, aes(time, x, group = vaccgrp, colour = factor(vaccgrp))) +

geom_point()+geom_line()+labs(title="NS data trial 1") +
xlab("Months post primary vaccination") + ylab("Titre")

ggplot(data=combined_titres2, aes(time, x, group = vaccgrp, colour = vaccgrp))
nsplot + geom_point()+geom_line()+labs(title="NS data trial 1") +
xlab("Months post primary vaccination") + ylab("Titre")
